title: sagina glabra
intro: Sagina glabra, commonly known as Marsh St. John's Wort, is a perennial herb native to Europe and North America, characterized by its delicate white flowers and small, oval-shaped leaves. The plant has been used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Sagina glabra include its potential to reduce stress and promote relaxation, making it a useful remedy for individuals experiencing emotional distress. Bioactive constituents in the plant, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, contribute to its therapeutic properties and may provide antioxidant and anti-inflammatory protection.
